name: Image Compare
summary: Side-by-side image comparison viewer with draggable slider control. Useful for before/after analysis.
executionNotes: Display-only node with no data output. Renders two images side-by-side with an interactive draggable slider that reveals more or less of each image for visual comparison. Does not produce output data and does not participate in computation flow.

exampleConnections.scenario: Compare an original image with a generated variation
Compare AI-generated output against reference image
